title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) Awards and the Outpatient Surgery Late-Change Fee
content:
For the late-change fee on a moved Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking under Good Faith & Price Estimates, an approved award of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) that covers the new scheduled service date lowers the share of the fee basis kept.

**Rule.** When the covering award's tier discount is above zero and below one hundred percent, the fee keeps one hundred percent less that discount of the fee basis. When the covering award carries no tier discount and has cap left, one half (0.5) of the fee basis is kept. In every other case all of it is kept.

**Terms as the records show them.** The patient's award is the patient's approved financial assistance case, a patient holding at most one approved case at a time. It covers the new scheduled service date when that date falls within its award period, from its award start date through its award end date, both counted. Its tier discount is the discount percentage of its Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) tier; its cap left is its hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case.

| Award covers the new date | Tier discount | Cap left | Share of the fee basis kept |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | above 0 and below 100 percent | any | 100 percent less the discount |
| yes | 0 | above zero | one half (0.5) |
| yes | 0 | none | all of it |
| yes | 100 percent | any | all of it |
| no, or no approved case | any | any | all of it |

## Examples (hypothetical)

- Covering award with an 80 percent tier discount: 20 percent of the fee basis is kept.
- Covering award with a 40 percent tier discount: 60 percent is kept.
- Covering hardship award with no tier discount and 500.00 of cap left: one half is kept.
